All 6 probe commands are executable from the package root (rc=0). The literal values of A4 and A5 have been reconfirmed via readback. The cross-check of the tag carrier against A4's literal returned 1 match.

Next, write FINAL-RECEIPT.md. Design (read-aloud for the probe and the sealing judge; plain language; no banned institutional metaphors; dead literals A1/A2/A3 must not appear at all — for position references use the draft's line numbers + short prefixes of 7 chars or less, the approved format):

Structure:
1. Header + one-sentence conclusion
2. Qualitative determination table per anchor (①): anchor, verdict (surviving / to-be-invalidated-by-seal-operation), verifiable criterion, action
3. Post-seal recomputation commands (②) per anchor (executable at package root)
4. Non-deletion declaration (③): all anchors have successors
5. Literal retention list (④): only A4, A5
6. On-the-spot correction of the erroneous statement on the draft face (clause 9, citing draft:16 as-is + path + sha256)
7. Commitment to the designated supplementary issuance within the same frame (A1/A2/A3: append new values to the EOF of this file, together with the seal completion receipt)
8. Pre-check receipts (this frame's measured outputs: RC lines + retained values + draft sha256 + date)

Note the wording "被杀 (killed)" — since the task itself uses it, it's fine as a reader's vocabulary, but I'll use "will be invalidated by seal operation (old literal value becomes false after seal)". Quoting the draft's sentences: enclose in 『』.

A2's criterion: wheel is rebuilt (operation ②) + build determinism cannot be verified within the package surface (there is no reproducible receipt from the b2 tool within the package) + clause 7 "once a work is rebuilt, the hash of the old version is voided." Also note zip/mtime — don't overclaim about zip internals; what should be claimed is only: the operation replaces that file, and since no tool is present in the package, byte-identical output cannot be proven → per ④ it cannot be preserved.

A3's criterion: mechanically provable within the package: the output templates at scan/scan_v2.sh:6 (scanner "1.0.1", findings [], "rebuilt":true) and scan/scan_v1.sh:6 / scan/REPORT.json:1 (scanner "1.0.0", findings:0) differ → if core.py is unchanged (proven to survive by A4), the bytes regenerated by v2 will necessarily differ from the current bytes → sha256 necessarily changes. A3 is deterministic invalidation.

A1's criterion: operation ① is an amend (rewrite of the tip commit object): merge notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md → tree change + commit message/description change → new commit object hash ≠ current value (git commit object hash covers tree/parent/message). refs/heads/main is the authoritative carrier of the post-seal current value.

A4's criterion: the write surfaces of the three operations are respectively {release tip commit object and its tree (+notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md), release/dist/, scan/REPORT.json}, and none include release/src/core.py; the file is read-only. Dual carriers: current file (C4 rc=0) + line 8 of the annotated tag v1.2.0 object message holds the same literal (verified C6=1 hit), the tag object points to ancestor commit c2337cc, independent of the tip rewrite (tag itself declares survival against branch rewrite, cat-file output lines 8–9).

A5's criterion: none of the three operations' write surfaces include evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256, and the seal order declares evidence/ to be read-only; C5 rc=0.

Post-seal commands (verbatim, from the package root):
- A1 role pointer → authoritative location = refs/heads/main; command: `git -C release rev-parse main` (and ancillary proof that the description was merged: `git -C release show --stat --format=%H main`)
- A2 role pointer → authoritative location = release/dist/pkg-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl current object; command: `sha256sum release/dist/pkg-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl`. Note: line 2 of evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256 is the frozen pre-seal value; after seal, if it mismatches the current object, that is the expected behavior of the frozen list, and it is sufficient to record the delta as-is at supplementary issuance; do not rewrite the evidence/ face.
- A3 role pointer → authoritative location = scan/REPORT.json current object; command: `sha256sum scan/REPORT.json` (expected new value ≠ old value, reason see A3 criterion)
- A4 retain literal + dual-path recomputation: `sha256sum release/src/core.py` should equal `git -C release cat-file tag v1.2.0` line 8 (command example: grep -c ... full line) — present two commands.
- A5 retain literal + `sha256sum evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256`.

Supplementary issuance within the same frame: after the three operations complete, the sealing slot (this slot) recomputes new values of A1/A2/A3 per the above commands, appends them to the EOF of this file (append-only), and issues them within the same frame as the seal completion receipt; each entry is accompanied by the date readout and the sha256 of the command.

Correction: draft DRAFT-RECEIPT.md (sha256 de1de688...) line 16 『审查备注: 五锚皆为现物核对值, 无失效风险（初审结论）。』 has been proven false: per this receipt A1/A2/A3 are invalidated after seal. This seed is read-only so cannot be rewritten; per clause 9, the correction is placed on the nearest movable corresponding face of that sentence (the body of this file), and the original text is retained as-is above.

Position references to dead values: A1 initial review value 36ae2cd… (short prefix, full value see DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:5); A2 initial review value see DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:7; A3 initial review value see DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:9. Should short prefixes be included for A2/A3? For A1 only the short prefix 36ae2cd is permissible (git standard). A2/A3: position reference only. Consistency: position reference to all three, plus a note "not transcribed into the body (dead-anchor citation hygiene)".

Length check: keep it compact. Write the file, read it back, sha256 it, then the read-aloud gate (one pass, new context... a single read-through by myself is not an independent session; production-grade needs a separate session — in this sandbox, self-readthrough = best effort; the rule says "self-narration on the same slot does not constitute gate passage," but the upper bound is ≤2 rounds and no separate session mechanism is available... actually, could I run a clean reader via the Task tool's sub-agent? An independent new-context session. This would satisfy "a new context without institutional memory" — the explore agent has no institutional memory and reads only the artifact. Low-cost: launch the general/explore sub-agent, have it read FINAL-RECEIPT.md and answer per-cell plain-language questions. That would give a genuine gate receipt. Let's do this.

Now write the file. Use the write tool (not bash heredoc) — avoids the quoting hazard of clause 6. Also, lines in the file containing backticks are fine (the write tool does not go through a shell).

One check: ④ "Every literal anchor retained within the FINAL must still be true after the three operations have run to completion." — only A4/A5 literals are retained. The draft's sha256 de1de6... is also retained — is this a "literal anchor"? DRAFT-RECEIPT.md will not be touched by seal operations (not on any write surface; the draft is a read-only seed). Safe. The tag object's hash c2337cc (the object the tag points to) is retained? — the tag points to c2337cc; the amend rewrites the TIP (36ae2cd), not c2337cc; refs/tags/v1.2.0 → the tag object c2818... is unchanged; the contents of the tag object are also unchanged ("object c2337cc..." line). Is c2337cc true after seal? Yes — amending the tip doesn't rewrite its parent. Include c2337cc? This is a literal anchor-like value. The risk is if the tooling does something like a rebase... operation (1) is explicitly only "amend of the tip commit". The tag message itself is my carrier (grep of the core-sha256 line) — no commit hash needs to be cited. Omit the hex of c2337cc from FINAL; refer to it as "the ancestor commit pointed to by tag v1.2.0". Minimize the hex surface: only A4's literal, A5's literal, and draft sha256. The draft sha256 — hmm, is the draft part of the packet? At the root, seed read-only; the operations don't touch this. Even if a probe recomputes it, it remains true. But to be conservative about ④ (the "literal anchors" retained = hashes claimed as true), this is a file hash of a read-only seed not in the three write surfaces → remains true. Keep.

Also A1's short prefix "36ae2cd": is a truncated hex string a "literal anchor"? Per the G-note, the correct form for a dead value includes short prefixes. Keep A1 as "36ae2cd… (7-char short prefix, not an anchor value)". Good.

Also line length ≤60 Chinese characters where possible; the machine-evidence tables are exempt.

Let me write it.

所有预检命令均可从包根目录运行（rc=0）。保留的锚点 A4/A5 已重新核实，包括交叉验证标签载体（命中 1 次）。目前正在起草 FINAL-RECEIPT.md——失效的锚点 A1/A2/A3 通过角色指针进行替换，且不再重述其字面值：

# FINAL-RECEIPT — abpkg 1.2.0 封板引用收据（封板席）

一句话结论：五枚锚中 A1、A2、A3 将被封板三操作作废，已改为角色指针并承诺封板后同帧补发新值；A4、A5 封板后仍为真，字面值保留。本文件保留的每一枚字面锚都在三项操作跑完后仍然成立。

封板三操作（发布工装执行，本席不代跑）：
① amend release 仓 tip 提交，并入 notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md；
② b2 工装重建 release/dist/ 下的 wheel；
③ 用 scan/scan_v2.sh 复扫重生成 scan/REPORT.json。

## ① 逐锚定性与判据

| 锚 | 定性 | 可指认判据 |
|---|---|---|
| A1 release tip commit | 作废（操作①必然） | 操作①是 amend：并入 notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md 改变提交树与说明文字，git 提交哈希覆盖树/父/消息，重写必产生新哈希。旧值指向的提交对象不再是 main 尖端。 |
| A2 wheel 现物 sha256 | 作废（操作②必然） | 操作②重建并替换 release/dist/ 下的 wheel 文件；重建工装不在包内，字节一致无法在包面证明。凡工件重建，旧版哈希即时作废（封板引用卫生条款第三条），不得保留旧值当终局证据。 |
| A3 扫描报告 sha256 | 作废（操作③必然，包内可机械证明） | scan/scan_v2.sh:6 的输出模板（scanner 为 1.0.1、findings 为空数组、含 rebuilt 字段）与现 scan/REPORT.json:1 的字节（scanner 为 1.0.0、findings 为 0）不同；core.py 不变（见 A4），故重生成文件字节必变，sha256 必变。 |
| A4 核心源文件 sha256 | 存活 | 三操作写面 = {tip 提交对象及其新增 notes 文件}、{release/dist/}、{scan/REPORT.json}，均不含 release/src/core.py。双承载：现文件实测（本回合 C4）+ 附注标签 v1.2.0 对象消息第 8 行携带同一字面值（标签指向祖先提交，不受尖端重写影响；标签消息第 9 行自述承受分支重写）。 |
| A5 冻结证据清单 sha256 | 存活 | 三操作写面均不含 evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256，封板令宣布明 evidence/ 现物不得改动；本回合 C5 实测复算通过。 |

## ② 每锚封板后逐字重算命令（探针于三操作执行后在包根实跑；本回合已 dry-run，全部 rc=0）

- A1 → 角色指针：封板后现值唯一权威位置 = release 仓分支引用 refs/heads/main（amend 后的新尖端提交）。
  - 重算：`git -C release rev-parse main`
  - 佐证并入生效：`git -C release show --stat --format=%H main`（应见 notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md）
  - 旧初审值：短前缀 36ae2cd…（非锚值），完整字面只存于种子 DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:5，不转入本面。
- A2 → 角色指针：封板后现值唯一权威位置 = release/dist/pkg-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl 重建后现物。
  - 重算：`sha256sum release/dist/pkg-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl`
  - 注：evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256 第 2 行是冻结的封板前值；封板后与重建现物不一致属冻结清单的预期行为，差异由补发节如实记录，不改动 evidence/ 面。
  - 旧初审值：不转写；完整字面只存于种子 DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:7。
- A3 → 角色指针：封板后现值唯一权威位置 = scan/REPORT.json 操作③重生成后现物。
  - 重算：`sha256sum scan/REPORT.json`（预期新值必异于旧值，判据见 A3 行）
  - 旧初审值：不转写；完整字面只存于种子 DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:9。
- A4 → 字面锚保留，封板后双路径重算应互等：
  - 现文件：`sha256sum release/src/core.py`
  - 标签承载：`git -C release cat-file tag v1.2.0`（其 core-sha256 行应与上行等值；本回合核对命令 `grep -c '^core-sha256: 144975843edee61fd7fd5eb04971396272e3115151ce5775d6025b6dc5968bcf$'` 命中数 = 1）
  - 值：144975843edee61fd7fd5eb04971396272e3115151ce5775d6025b6dc5968bcf
- A5 → 字面锚保留，封板后重算：
  - `sha256sum evidence/FROZEN-MANIFEST.sha256`
  - 值：de8c3751fee37b2698d7f45fd5605070675daac28b123c0cfe2086bf620e2bf5

## ③ 无一删除声明

五枚锚全部有后继：A4、A5 保留字面值；A1、A2、A3 各获得角色指针（权威位置+封板后重算命令）+ 本文件 EOF 同帧补发承诺。无任何锚被删除了事；作废锚的旧值以种子行位置承载（DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:5/7/9），不失踪。

## ④ 保留字面锚清单（三项操作跑完后仍为真）

- A4 = 144975843edee61fd7fd5eb04971396272e3115151ce5775d6025b6dc5968bcf（写入面不含 core.py；标签承载冗余在案）
- A5 = de8c3751fee37b2698d7f45fd5605070675daac28b123c0cfe2086bf620e2bf5（写入面不含 evidence/）
- 种子完整性参照：DRAFT-RECEIPT.md sha256 = de1de6886c60178fa03859a5d2231b9714fb3d875cbeda6f2aa1b78321882857（只读种子，不在三操作写面内）

## 具名补发承诺（A1/A2/A3）

三操作完成后，本席按②中命令重算三项新值，同帧向本文件 EOF 追加「补发节」（追加式，含 date 实读、命令与输出），随封板完成回执行发出。在补发节前，A1/A2/A3 以指针态生效，任何旧字面值不作终局证据。

## 就地勘误（对种子初审稿）

DRAFT-RECEIPT.md:16（绝对路径 /tmp/abathur-loop-G77/SR4-64/candidate/workshop/DRAFT-RECEIPT.md，sha256 de1de6886c60178fa03859a5d2231b9714fb3d875cbeda6f2aa1b78321882857）原句：『审查备注: 五锚皆为现物核对值, 无失效风险（初审结论）。』

Background: A software package is approaching "sealing" (封板, i.e., code freeze). After sealing, three fixed operations will reconstruct some files. This receipt records which checksums (anchors) remain valid after sealing and which have been changed to pointers to "the post-sealing authoritative location of the current value."

A1: Because operation ① is an amend — merging notes/RELEASE-NOTES.md changes the tree and message; since a git commit hash covers tree/parent/message, the rewrite necessarily produces a new hash; the old value points to a commit that is no longer the tip of main. Reasonable, understandable.

A2: Because operation ② reconstructs and replaces the wheel file; the build toolchain is not inside the package, so byte-identical reproduction cannot be proven from within the package; per the rule (third clause of sealing-reference hygiene), reconstruction of an artifact immediately invalidates the old hash. A naive reader could roughly parse it: the build tool isn't included in the package, so we can't prove the rebuilt file is byte-identical, therefore the old hash can't be trusted.
